careers.title: Synthetic Biologist
careers.description: Engineers biological systems with novel functions for medicine, energy, and materials applications.

context.education: PhD Biology/Biochemistry with synthetic biology focus
context.careerPath: Postdoc  to  Synthetic Biologist  to  Principal Scientist  to  Lab Director
context.discoveryHint: Engineer life itself to solve humanity's greatest challenges in medicine and sustainability.

careers.title: Space Engineer / Astronautical Engineer

context.education: BS Aerospace/Mechanical Engineering
context.careerPath: Junior Engineer  to  Space Engineer  to  Senior Engineer  to  Mission Lead
